sloka: इमम् तस्य महा भाग दूतम् दुष्कर कारिणः ।वन वासात् अनुप्राप्तम् कस्मान् न प्रतिभाषसे ॥२-५७-२९॥
transliteration: imam tasya mahā bhāga dūtam duṣkara kāriṇaḥ ।vana vāsāt anuprāptam kasmān na pratibhāṣase ॥2-57-29॥

translations.english: O distinguished king, why are you not enquiring from the messenger about him (Rama) who is capable of performing arduous tasks?
